modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Singapore Airlines publishes separate cutoffs for online check-in, mobile check-in, airport counters and boarding gates.
body: For most trips, Singapore Airlines website check-in is available from 48 hours to 1.5 hours before departure, while SingaporeAir mobile app check-in is available from 48 hours to 1 hour before departure.

At the airport, Singapore Airlines says check-in counters close 40 minutes before departure and recommends arriving three hours early, especially when checking baggage. Boarding gates close 15 minutes before departure, and some bag-drop or self-service options have airport-specific opening and closing times.

website_checkin_window.value: Website check-in is available from 48 hours to 1.5 hours before flight departure.
website_checkin_window.notes: Singapore Airlines' online and mobile check-in page states the website check-in window.

mobile_checkin_window.value: SingaporeAir mobile app check-in is available from 48 hours to 1 hour before flight departure.
mobile_checkin_window.notes: Singapore Airlines' online and mobile check-in page states the mobile app check-in window.

airport_counter_cutoff.value: Airport check-in counters close 40 minutes before departure; Singapore Airlines recommends arriving three hours early, especially with checked baggage.
airport_counter_cutoff.notes: Singapore Airlines' airport check-in page states the counter closing time and arrival guidance.

boarding_gate_cutoff.value: Boarding gates close 15 minutes before departure.
boarding_gate_cutoff.notes: Singapore Airlines' boarding page states the gate closing time.

bag_drop_variation.value: Automated bag-drop and self-service timings vary by airport, so travellers should check the airport-specific Singapore Airlines guidance for their departure point.
bag_drop_variation.notes: Singapore Airlines' automated bag-drop page lists different opening and closing times by airport.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Passenger rights on Singapore Airlines depend on the operating carrier, departure country, arrival country and the regulation attached to the itinerary.
body: For flights covered by European passenger-rights rules, Singapore Airlines says qualifying departure delays may trigger meals, refreshments and communications, with hotel accommodation and hotel transport when the delay pushes travel to the next day.

Singapore Airlines also publishes refund and disruption commitments for U.S.-covered travel, including prompt refunds when ticket refunds are due and practical assistance such as meals, accommodation, rebooking help and transport where possible during cancellations, delays and misconnections.

eu_delay_assistance.value: EU-covered flights delayed at departure by 2, 3 or 4 hours, depending on distance and route type, may qualify for meals, refreshments and communications.
eu_delay_assistance.notes: Singapore Airlines' European passenger-rights page lists care thresholds by flight distance and route type.

eu_five_hour_refund.value: For EU-covered departure delays of more than 5 hours, passengers may cancel and obtain a refund of the unused portion of the ticket, with a return flight when relevant.
eu_five_hour_refund.notes: Singapore Airlines' European passenger-rights page explains the five-hour delay refund option.

us_refund_timing.value: For eligible U.S.-covered refunds, Singapore Airlines says refunds are provided within 7 business days for credit-card purchases and within 20 business days for cash or check purchases.
us_refund_timing.notes: Singapore Airlines' customer service plan states refund timing for eligible refunds.

disruption_assistance.value: When Singapore Airlines cancels, diverts or delays a flight, it says it will try to provide meals, accommodation, rebooking assistance and transport to accommodation to reduce passenger inconvenience.
disruption_assistance.notes: Singapore Airlines' customer service plan describes disruption assistance for cancellations, diversions, delays and misconnections.

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
